text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. was defeated in the Satsuki Sho. 
Though the crowd lamented the shattered 
dream of a Classic Triple Crown, they 
still praised her incredible run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having raced through covered head-to-toe 
in mud, Mr. C.B. expresses her frustration 
over the defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the Japanese Derby. 
Looking ahead to facing the next strong 
umamusume, Mr. C.B. burned with fighting 
spirit.
